rationale: The candidate correctly explains that the default `BoolP("help", "h", ...)` flag makes the two spellings indistinguishable, but it does not answer the broader question correctly. The bundle explicitly says `InitDefaultHelpFlag` “will do nothing” when `c.Flags().Lookup("help") != nil` (`command.go:1183-1198`), supporting the possibility of predeclaring a custom `help` flag and handling `-h` separately. The candidate’s qualified “No” omits this supported customization path, so it is insufficient.
